messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: decode-streaming pod(s) on gpu-node-12 OOM spike detected, 11 OOMs in 7m, auto-remediate triggered -> quarantining pod. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/decode-oom
Sanjay: seeing sustained decode OOMs on streaming lane, looks correlated with long-tail token counts. dashboard: https://metrics/streams/overview
Miguel: any recent deploys? logs show CUDA exception: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED in decode_loop
Elaine: telemetry: sudden increase in open streaming sessions from api-key=key_Abc123; avg tokens/session jumped to ~18k vs baseline 120. looks like runaway generation (no stop tokens)
Laura: acknowledged, I'm oncall. Immediate mitigations: 1) enable global token ceiling on gateway 2) throttle streaming rate for that API key 3) route new requests to smaller model variant. executing now.
Laura: Applying global cap -> rwinferctl config set global.max_tokens_per_request 2048 --env prod
oncall-bot: command run by Laura at 1830001360: rwinferctl config set ... -> OK :white_check_mark:
Miguel: patching route to model-small-v2 for streaming-slot-3: kubectl patch route streaming-slot-3 --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/model","value":"model-small-v2"}]'
Eli: quarantining API key key_Abc123 -> rwinferctl keys quarantine key_Abc123 --reason "runaway-generation" :lock:
Nina: node12 restarted by kube & pods rescheduled, memory pressure cleared, OOM count dropped to 0 in last 3m
Sanjay: telemetry after mitigations: 95% reduction in high-token streams, request drop rate back to baseline. Still seeing ~0.2% 500s; investigating retried flows
customer-success: impacted customers identified: AcmeCorp (high-volume), MedSys (esp streaming transcripts), Chatly. Crafting CS note.
customer-success: Suggested update: "We experienced degraded streaming reliability due to clients sending extremely long generation requests which triggered GPU OOMs. We've applied a global token cap and quarantined offending API keys. Systems stabilized at 18:45 UTC. We're performing a post-incident analysis and will follow up."
Laura: follow-ups: - postmortem owner: Sanjay - action items: enforce client-side token limits in SDK, server-side soft-fail before enqueue, add anomaly alert on tokens/session > 5k, consider per-key rate limits. Assigning tickets.
Sanjay: assigning jira RW-7891 (postmortem) and RW-7892 (prod guardrails)
Miguel: root cause: client bypassed token header with chunked streaming that didn't set stop tokens; decoder/kv-cache growth + long-tail combined with a model rollout edge-case causing unchecked allocation. We'll include kernel error trace in postmortem.
Laura: leaving oncall note & reopening if regressions. monitoring channel: https://metrics/alerts/streaming-ooms
Sanjay: closing thread for active mitigation. Will update postmortem when ready. :thumbsup:
